name: Tofu Poke Bowl
steps: Rinse the sushi rice in several changes of water until the water runs nearly clear. Add the measured 480 ml water, bring to a boil, cover and cook over very low heat for 12–15 minutes. Turn off the heat and rest covered for 10 minutes. Dissolve the sugar in 20 ml rice vinegar, fold gently into the rice and let it cool until just warm.

Press the drained extra-firm tofu between clean towels for 15 minutes, then cut into bite-sized cubes. Mix soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, grated ginger and the remaining 15 ml rice vinegar. Toss the tofu in this mixture and marinate for 10 minutes, reserving any marinade for finishing.

Heat the neutral oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Lift the tofu from the marinade and sear for 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned. Pour in only the remaining marinade and simmer briefly until it coats the tofu; do not leave raw marinade standing at room temperature. Let the tofu cool slightly.

Cook the shelled edamame if needed according to its pack, drain and cool. Slice cucumber and radishes thinly, cut carrot into ribbons, slice spring onions and prepare nori strips. Slice the avocado last so it does not brown.

Divide the seasoned sushi rice among four bowls. Arrange the glazed tofu, edamame, cucumber, carrot, radish and avocado in distinct sections. Sprinkle with spring onion, sesame seeds and nori. Serve promptly while the rice is slightly warm and the vegetables crisp.
tips: Use cooked shelled edamame and extra-firm tofu that holds its shape. The reviewed photo shows browned soy-sesame tofu cubes, white rice, edamame, cucumber, carrot, radish, avocado, scallion, sesame and nori in separate sections; there is no fish.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
